title: Authenticate websocket task logs and publish richer task status events
description: Protect websocket log access with task ownership checks and make status frames carry enough data for the UI to show truthful terminal outcomes.
action: In backend/api/v2/websocket.py, require a token query parameter on /ws/tasks/{task_id}/logs, decode it with backend/core/security.py access-token rules, and call task_service.get_task() before websocket_manager.connect(); in backend/services/task_service.py, publish status websocket payloads with task_id, status, result, error, and finished_at; in frontend/src/composables/useTaskLogs.ts, frontend/src/views/Sites/SiteEditor.vue, and frontend/src/views/Tasks/TaskList.vue, append token=encodeURIComponent(localStorage.getItem("access_token") || "") to websocket URLs and consume richer status payloads where applicable; keep the route path /ws/tasks/{task_id}/logs unchanged.
scope: websocket auth and task status propagation

convergence.definition_of_done: Only an authenticated owner can open task log websockets, and status frames include the task result/error needed by the UI.

files.change: Decode an access token from the websocket query string and authorize task access before connecting.
Publish task_id, status, result, error, and finished_at in the websocket status payload.
Append the stored access token to the websocket URL and consume result/error fields from status frames.
Append the stored access token to the direct websocket URL used for task logs and preserve the existing after_id replay behavior.
Append the stored access token to the direct websocket URL used for queued/running task log streaming.
Add websocket tests for unauthorized access denial and authorized log replay.

implementation: Add a small websocket token parsing path that accepts token from the query string and validates it with decode_token() and the existing user lookup rules.
Authorize websocket access by calling task_service.get_task() before accepting the connection so task ownership matches the REST APIs.
Extend task_service.update_status() websocket publication to include result, error, and finished_at fields in addition to status.
Update frontend/src/composables/useTaskLogs.ts to append access_token from localStorage to the websocket URL and preserve reconnect behavior.
Update frontend/src/views/Sites/SiteEditor.vue and frontend/src/views/Tasks/TaskList.vue so both direct WebSocket callers append the same token query parameter.
Add pytest websocket coverage for unauthorized rejection and authorized history replay.

success_metrics: Authorized websocket status frames include result/error fields

reference.pattern: Authenticated REST task access already uses task_service.get_task()

rationale.chosen_approach: This reuses the existing JWT and task ownership logic and keeps the websocket route stable for the frontend.
decision_factors: Browsers cannot set arbitrary Authorization headers on WebSocket easily
REST task routes already have correct ownership checks
UI needs more than bare status strings to show truthful terminal state
rationale.tradeoffs: The websocket URL now carries a short-lived access token in the query string, but only over the existing same-origin channel.

risks: Avoid calling websocket_manager.connect() before authorization succeeds.
